run_absl_time_tests: run the absl time test suite to verify pybind11 casters for duration and datetime types
run_absl_numeric_span_tests: run the absl numeric span test suite to verify casting between Python sequences and C++ spans
run_absl_string_view_tests: run the absl string view test suite to verify casting between Python strings and absl::string_view
run_absl_hash_map_tests: run the absl hash map and hash set test suite to verify casting between Python dicts and absl containers
run_absl_optional_variant_tests: run the absl optional and variant test suite to verify casting between Python None and absl::optional
